description: Test whether the Cys3 metal site partitions the SSF111126 superfamily into a V4R/BchJ branch and a heme-binding H-NOX branch
code:
import pandas as pd, numpy as np
from scipy.stats import chi2_contingency
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
df=pd.read_csv("out/homolog_site_residues.csv")
df['nCys']=(df.C159=='C').astype(int)+(df.C185=='C').astype(int)+(df.C193=='C').astype(int)
df['hasE']=(df.E182=='E')
nm=df.name.fillna('')
def cat(s):
    s=s.lower()
    if 'guanylate' in s or 'h-nox' in s or 'heme no' in s: return "H-NOX / guanylate cyclase"
    if 'vinyl' in s or 'bchj' in s or '4vr' in s: return "V4R / BchJ-like"
    return "other / uncharacterised"
df['cat']=nm.map(cat)
ct=pd.crosstab(df.cat, df.nCys==3)
ct.columns=["<3 Cys","Cys3 complete"]
print("Cys3 site by family branch (n=%d homologs):"%len(df))
print(ct.to_string())
print("\nfraction Cys3-complete:")
print((ct["Cys3 complete"]/ct.sum(1)).round(3).to_string())
chi2,p,dof,_=chi2_contingency(ct.values)
print("chi2=%.1f, dof=%d, p=%.3g"%(chi2,dof,p))
ct2=pd.crosstab(df.cat, df.hasE); ct2.columns=["no E182-equivalent","E182-equivalent Glu"]
print("\nGlu at the BchJ E182 position:")
print(ct2.to_string())
print((ct2["E182-equivalent Glu"]/ct2.sum(1)).round(3).to_string())

fig,ax=plt.subplots(figsize=(8.5,4.2))
frac=(ct["Cys3 complete"]/ct.sum(1)).sort_values()
bars=ax.barh(frac.index, frac.values, color=["#4c78a8","#bab0ac","#e45756"])
for y,v,n in zip(range(len(frac)), frac.values, ct.sum(1)[frac.index]):
    ax.text(v+0.01, y, "%.0f%% of %d"%(100*v,n), va='center')
ax.set_xlim(0,1); ax.set_xlabel("fraction of homologs retaining C159, C185 and C193")
ax.set_title("The Cys3 metal site splits the SSF111126 superfamily:\nkept in the V4R/BchJ branch, lost in the heme-binding H-NOX branch")
plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()
